title: Three Men in Tuxedo and Suits, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white photograph taken on October 28, 1950, featuring three young men standing together outdoors. The gentleman in the center wears a formal black tuxedo with a black bow tie and a white carnation boutonniere, suggesting a wedding or formal ceremony. His companions flank him wearing wide-lapel double-breasted pinstriped suits, characteristic of post-WWII American menswear fashion.
